frame: docs/design/rulings-2026-10-23d.md (the daze, the sell and the rally; behind rally.enabled)

links.name: Palm Turn
links.input: the chase (LT with X or Y) with the stick held across his flight, up or down, instead of back against it
links.what: the zip passes the body and an open palm meets it side-on, turning it 90 degrees onto the stick's line: up into the sky, or down to the ground. The overtake's power. With a neutral stick it turns up and away from people
links.destination: open_air or ground, the stick's choice
links.price: the zip's (20 with X, 30 with Y)
links.tech: item 8: 4 ticks the first time in a rally, 8 if the last link was this one, a third in a rally is teched by itself
links.tell: his hips turn as he passes, the palm edge-forward
links.look: a flat palm, a turn of the wrist, the body's line bends at a right angle in a burst of cyan

links.name: Net Haul
links.input: RB with A at the body in flight (the energy link, 23d item 6)
links.what: Harbour Net catches the body in the air; his payoff, the yank, hauls it into his reach mid-air and his next press lands a blow that sends it on along the stick, with no zip to pay
links.tech: item 8: 4 ticks the first time in a rally, 8 if the last link was this one, a third in a rally is teched by itself
links.tell: the open hand draws the tow line back to the shoulder
links.look: the net flares round the arms and torso; he hauls hand over hand, then the palm
links.legal: the net binds arms and torso; one call-out on the throw or the catch's first 10 ticks (ln06); nothing said over the haul

links.name: Pillar Lift
links.input: no press: a send that carries the body across his own armed Trip Pillar (TRAP LANDING, Game Design 20 item 12)
links.what: the pillar rises under the body and throws it up and away from people, a knock-back of up to 6 bh (20 item 2), keeping it in the air for his next link
links.price: none at the time (the trap's 12 ki when laid)
links.tech: item 8: 4 ticks the first time in a rally, 8 if the last link was this one, a third in a rally is teched by itself
links.tell: the pillar's seams flare for 6 ticks
links.look: a stone slab rising under the body, tilted away from the houses
links.legal: a solid slab, never a beam of light or around a body (e14)

sell._frame: 23d item 4: in the daze each landed medium or heavy takes the launch's hit-stop (12), a camera push and a reaction a size larger; the sell is the look, never the number

medium.head: snaps aside and rolls through the neck; his eyes come back first
medium.body: a half step back on sliding feet, arms open
medium.recover: pulled in again with a grin

heavy.head: driven down and round
heavy.body: folds over the blow, breath forced out in a visible gust, driven back a step
heavy.recover: a short laugh and a nod: he grades it

send.look: launched with his arms flung wide, still grinning; he turns in the air to watch who sent him

sell.voice: a grunt, then a laugh on the recovery; never an apology
sell._legal: the body is never limp; no slow motion beyond the hit-stop, no taunt over a dazed fighter; each sold blow is one flash event at most (fx08)

legalAsks: the palm turn's open palm and wrist turn
the net haul in the air (binds, call-out)
the pillar under a flying body
openQuestions: Palm Turn reads the stick across the flight; does any device misread it against the overtake's stick held back?
